text: Vonovia SE is a listed company based in Bochum (Bochum Local Court, HRB 16879). Its half-year presentation of 5 August 2026 names Norges Bank, which manages Norway’s sovereign wealth fund, as its largest shareholder with 14.0%, and shows BlackRock with 8.0%, APG with 3.7% and 74.3% other free float (as of 30 June 2026).

additionalSources.quote: Die Norges Bank ist mit insgesamt 14,0 % größter Anteilseigner von Vonovia.
additionalSources.note: Translation: 'Norges Bank, with 14.0% in total, is Vonovia's largest shareholder.' The next sentence says it manages the Norwegian sovereign wealth fund. The shareholder-structure chart on the same slide (as of 30 June 2026) shows Norges 14.0%, BlackRock 8.0%, APG 3.7% and other free float 74.3%. A PDF presentation dated Bochum, 5 August 2026.
